body: Four notches on the hoe, four on the camera. A fifth is filed down on both. Bound with roadblock tape. Last frame: empty checkpoint.
title: garden hoe and camera

body:
I marked the water barrel too, after the field crew sprayed the rows upwind. They call the rinse routine; I still will not let the dog drink until the tank is flushed.

The barrel water had a green skin on it by morning and the beans nearest the spray went limp. I wrote the time before I went back for the others.
title: Letter
